meta.description: Add Telegram channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Telegram 频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Telegram 频道消息功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Telegram channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Telegram channel messaging to your application

howto.what: 装上后，系统会多出 Telegram 机器人渠道：复制并注册适配器、安装依赖并跑通测试；按提示用 BotFather 建机器人、配对聊天后，就能在 Telegram 里收发消息。
howto.when: 当你想把系统接入 Telegram、用机器人收发消息时使用。整个流程会自动安装代码、引导你创建机器人并完成配对。

say.text: 把 Telegram 渠道加进来。
say.note: 系统会开始安装适配器并引导你创建机器人。

say.text: 帮我接入 Telegram 机器人。
say.note: 它会从代码安装一直做到配对步骤。
完成后就能用 Telegram 和系统对话。

howto.what_en: Adds a Telegram bot channel to the system: copies and registers the adapter, installs the dependency, runs tests, then guides you through BotFather bot creation and a pairing handshake so the system can send/receive Telegram messages.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want to connect the system to Telegram and have a bot handle messages. The flow installs code, prompts for bot creation, and pairs your chat.

say_en.note: It starts installing the adapter and walks you through bot creation.
It goes from code install through the pairing step.
After it's done, you can talk with the system on Telegram.
